name: Brownfruit Rush
desc: Brownfruit Rush (Juncus pelocarpus): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 15 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Juncus pelocarpus, the brown-fruit rush, is a species of flowering plant in the family Juncaceae, native to British Columbia and eastern Canada, and the north-central and eastern United States.
